blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has opened up about the “biggest earthquake” in his life: his family’s exile to Hawaii in 1986. In a candid interview during the season finale of the “Unshaken With Gary V” podcast, uploaded on Monday, Marcos recounted one of the most significant events in Philippine history. READ: Marcos’ martial law: Golden age for corruption, abuses During the podcast, Filipino music icon Gary Valenciano asked Marcos to walk him through a moment or season in his life when everything was shaken. Marcos, without hesitation, said it was when his family fled the Philippines for Hawaii […]... Keep on reading: Marcos recalls ‘biggest earthquake’ during Hawaii exile
